title: Rend Vision (Dire Raven)
html:
This article is about the attack used by Dire Ravens. For the other versions, see Rend Vision (disambiguation).
Rend Vision is an attack available to Dire Ravens including Beast Master's  Dire Raven Companion or druids in  Wild Shape: Dire Raven form. It is a melee attack that does ⁠Piercing damage which scales with the raven's level and blinds its target.

Description

Attack a creature's eyes and  Blind it.

Properties

Cost
 Action
Damage: 1~6 + modifiers
1d6 + Dexterity modifier⁠Piercing
Details
 Melee Unarmed Attack Roll
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)

At higher levels

This attack deals scaling bonus damage at higher levels:

  • +1d4⁠Piercing at level 4 for druids or level 5 for Beast Master companions (Corvus Major)
  • +1d6⁠Piercing at level 8 for druids or level 11 for Beast Master companions (Corvus Celer)
  • +1d8⁠Piercing at level 12 for druids

Technical details

UID
Target_RendVision_Raven_Summon
Spell flags
IsHarmful, IsMelee

Condition: Blinded

 Blinded

Duration: 2 turns

  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.

How to learn

Used by creatures: Corvus, Corvus Celer, Corvus Major, Polymorph: Dire Raven, Raven (white), and Wild Shape: Dire Raven

Notes

  • There is no saving throw to avoid the  Blinded effect. The attack merely needs to hit for the effect to be applied.
  • In  Wild Shape: Dire Raven form, this attack gains an additional attack bonus from Strength modifier with  Tavern Brawler feat even though the normal attack bonus is determined by Dexterity modifier.
  • Beast Master companions' levels increase in discrete steps at levels 5, 7, and 11 so it will not receive the level 4 bonus damage until level 5 (Corvus Major) or the level 8 bonus damage until level 11 (Corvus Celer). It will never receive the level 12 damage upgrade.
